name: Price tag
summary: Card price tag on a string with a hole and a percent mark; anim swing for sales and discounts.

params.name: y
params.note: pivot: the point where the string hangs from (not the bottom); the tag hangs below it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 380 px wide and 400 px tall including the string

params.name: anim
params.note: swing = the tag swings gently from the pivot

author: krakujs
